title: Activated charcoal modified Ag and Cu-anatase TiO2 for superior photocatalytic degradation of doxycycline under visible-solar light irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20999-21015
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00006A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kirti Bisht, Davinder Kaur, Bonamali Pal
The effect of activated charcoal and Ag/Cu loading on TiO2 for the degradation of doxycycline under visible & solar light is shown. The Cu2TC1 composite exhibits enhanced photocatalytic degradation (98.5%) compared to bare TiO2 (68.7%) under sunlight.
